> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Outcome

Every finished build's proof gets an adversarial check by a different company's model before the card moves on.

## Acceptance criteria

* A different company's model reviews each finished build's proof adversarially, starting from unproven and trying to break each claim, with nobody pressing anything.
* The Linear card shows a verdict per criterion: proven, unproven or wrong thing tested.
* When a review fails, the card moves to Remediation for one round of defect fixing following poteto-mode's Bug fix playbook, then a fresh review. When that second review also fails, an Investigation run following poteto-mode's Investigation playbook finds the root cause and the card stops. The machine refuses a run whose checklist follows a different playbook.
